sourceOrderMappingLimit: The private overlay labels AcquireAsync uniformly. Six call-site names are a source-order inference from this synchronous route and observed entry/invoker/send boundaries; the exact timed intervals themselves are directly recorded. No caller-stack payload was retained.
clockMethod: Same-host Stopwatch timestamps plus existing Activity identifiers. Parent ordinal IDs are assembly/process local. Each root is analyzed separately; overlapping inclusive spans are never added as a critical path. Begin/end record timestamps and elapsed measurements differ slightly because instrumentation writes are included.

exactObservationExample.overlapLimit: Image reads include fresh first-pass and Complete reads and overlap the Complete span; do not add image sum to Complete. Schema Counted only instruments the Schema method; Complete schema regeneration is inside the inclusive Complete span.

conclusion: Fresh technical host inventory and serial catalog acquisition/release wrapping dominate this captured owner path. Actual actor pair bodies and state reads are small. Template matching and the now-memoized activation binding do not explain the remaining hundreds of milliseconds.

repairAssessment.templateParsing: Reject as a next material optimization on this evidence. All gateway template matches total about80ms across the complete three-root diagnostic, while image read/hash calls total about2005ms.
repairAssessment.authorityGate: Material queue waits are directly observed. Any refinement must preserve every fresh read/trust/host capture, lease state/CAS fencing, epoch rechecks and release semantics. Removing checks or merging authority observations is not justified. Queue savings alone are not proven sufficient for the frozen deadline.
repairAssessment.freshImageComputation: The dominant measured pure-work candidate is TechnicalHttpActionObservation.AssemblyIdentity. A bounded host-owned memo of deterministic digest computation could compare the complete newly read privately owned image bytes exactly before reuse, preserving both first-pass and Complete fresh reads/MVID validation and changed-byte refusal. These timings combine file read, PE inspection and hashing, so they do not establish the hashing-only saving; benchmark those costs before choosing it. No file/reference/mtime/length-only cache or authority result cache is justified.

limits: Private instrumentation changes the measured latency, including per-span serialization/filesystem work and aggregate bookkeeping. It localizes the cost boundary and is not ordinary performance acceptance or a saving benchmark.
